deposit.rule: progress = clamp(progress + netcoin, 0, 1000); netcoin = 0 (excess over 1000 is lost)
deposit.tick_sound: res://Audio/SFX/Tick3.ogg, pitch offset = tween elapsed time, 2-frame cooldown

ending_timeline.event: lock mouse; show 'deploying virus...' with loading circle rotating -180 deg/s; play Deploying.ogg
show 'virus deployed!' + Smile.png + 'ok' button; play Deployed.ogg; achievement DEPLOY_GODVIRUS
show glitch overlay (shake_power 0); BGM volume -> 0 and low-pass -> 500 Hz over 10 s
Static.ogg volume 0 -> 1 and glitch shake_power 0 -> 0.8, both over 10 s (linear)
stop static; play VoiceLoop.ogg and VCR.ogg; freeze the screen on a screenshot; hide glitch
stop voice; show black credits screen
credits animation, 16.5 s: 'nodebuster' 0-3.5, 'a game by Goblobin' 4-7.5, 'with music by Holizna' 8-11.5, 'thanks for playing <3' 13-16.5 (font size 22)
return to main menu (no transition); unlock mouse
